finding: In cesarean section, delayed cord clamping for 30-60 seconds improved the early hematological status of term neonates without the enhanced requirement of phototherapy for neonatal jaundice.
mod_finding: Delayed cord clamping for 30-60 s resulted in the higher neonatal hemoglobin level on day 3 and an increased rate of neonatal polycythemia, without a higher rate of phototherapy.
